attestations.text: Liu Jung 劉蓉 (T. 孟容, H. 霞仙, 1816–1873), a native of Hunan who, as a capable secretary and counselor of Tsêng Kuo-fan, served Lo in the same capacity. On October 18, 1861 he was formally installed as governor-general at Chengtu and started to make an end of the insurgents.
